scope: R0+R1 (one tranche), stop point = delivery of trained weights and development results
authorises_nothing: No spending, install, corpus generation, training or reserve read before explicit approval of the tranche.

v6.role: experimental reference and constraint base, not ceiling

hypotheses.statement: H1 (entity memory + typed graph) yields lower event NLL and trajectory CRPS than B2 (aggregate memory) and B0-local (recalibrated mechanisms) at H6 and H24 on unseen REF establishments.
The gain of HP1 is concentrated where hidden mechanisms m2/m3 are active; where only m0/m1 act, B0-local is not worse than H1 beyond a declared margin.
Paired action/control effect errors are smaller for H1 than B2 and B0-local, including correct recognition of null effects.
Per-instant decision regret against C_full is smaller for H1 than for B0-local, only if the R0 precheck margin is informative.
Simple-model sufficiency is a valid outcome: if B0-local matches H1, this is reported as such.

action_catalogue.a1: discharge logistics for publicly authorised stays
action_catalogue.a3: reinforcement request (skill x unit x slot x source)

mechanisms.m0: independent delays, fixed laws per establishment
mechanisms.m5: correlated transport/cleaning delays, capacity change, order-dependent tasks (DIAG only)

world.mechanism_status: engineering hypotheses; none validated on real data or by interviews

independent_generator.name: G_alt
independent_generator.implementation: fixed time step, written separately from event-driven G_main

REF.purpose: motivated reference population, includes cases where simple models suffice

DIAG.purpose: difficulty diagnostic (resource conflicts, correlated delays, changing capacity, delayed observations, order-dependent decisions)
DIAG.frequency_claim: none: no real frequency is inferred from this stress test

populations.rule: Population laws and mixture weights are fixed in G0 before any generation; they are never tuned on any model's gain; no simple-case removal from any partition.

partitions.unit: establishment (all its days, windows, branches and decision instants stay together)

VAL.use: early stopping, lr choice, overshooting weights, R0 precheck

DEVTEST.use: read once after F1; development results

RESERVE.state: seeds sealed by hash in G0; generator refuses without token; NOT generated in R1

partitions.P5_reserves: known historical regression data only (test V0), not a blind evaluation

information_sets.I_public_W: public observations with available_at <= t and event_time <= t over the last W hours (all compared systems)
information_sets.I_snapshot: public state at t only (C_pub-snap, B0-pool snapshot mode)
information_sets.I_param: true theta_h + public state (C_param, evaluation only)
information_sets.I_full: true theta_h + true current latent state, no future innovations (C_full, evaluation only)
information_sets.I_clairvoyant: realised future (oracle ceiling, never a target)

comparators.primary_model_comparison: same planner, same candidate set (identical hash), same public history, same resources, same sample budget M
comparators.V0: v6 historical on its own domain: non-regression (tests/decision_support, v6 tree diff empty, P5b EVAL_CHOICES regression sample)
comparators.B0_pool: explicit m0+m1 laws, censored MLE on TRAIN, common parameters
comparators.B0_local: B0_pool + empirical-Bayes shrinkage on the same public window W (mandatory calibrated-simulator reference)
comparators.B2: aggregate hourly vector -> GRU(64) -> distributional heads; no entity memory, no message passing
comparators.H1: typed-graph encoder (shared weights per type), 2 message-passing rounds per hour, shared node GRU(48) with type embedding, same heads
comparators.parameter_counts: exact counts measured after construction; expected B2 ~0.08 M, H1 ~0.15-0.25 M

interfaces_disabled_in_R1.rule: one variation at a time, in R2

losses: all losses are discrete NLL (15-min hazard bins, NB counts, Bernoulli, 5-min care bins); no continuous density in any loss

loss_normalisation.rule: s_f = mean TRAIN NLL of B0-pool for family f; common to all models/lr/seeds; frozen before B2/H1 training

training.privileged_supervision: post-freeze linear probes only (m2 regime, theta_h, true readiness); reads_private=True; refused as planner backend
training.selection: lr in {3e-4,1e-3} chosen by lowest VAL loss at seed 0 (tie within 1e-4 relative -> smaller lr); seeds 1,2 at chosen lr; per-seed checkpoint = best VAL loss

origins.TRAIN: every 3 h from 24 h to 165 h per establishment
origins.VAL: every hour from 24 h to 143 h

forecast: event NLL by type at H1/H6/H24
CRPS of levels (occupancy, compatible free beds, transport queue, cleaning queue, care minutes by skill)
peak error and hours-above-threshold error on full trajectories
ensemble dispersion reported separately from coverage

decision_diagnostic.after_instant_policy: habitual rule (single-decision effect isolated); closed loop is R3

precheck_R0.rule: if V_param + V_latent < delta_dec, the R1 decision comparison on REF is declared non-informative before any model is read; forecasting comparison continues; generator is not changed

objective_U.name: U-HOWM-1
objective_U.window: (tau, tau+24h] after decision instant tau, under realised private truth
objective_U.formula: sum over skill x hour of uncovered care minutes (demand minus PRESENT capacity, floored at 0, admission work due included) + 15 x patient-hours waiting for a compatible bed

weight_wait.status: engineering hypothesis, not validated; U also reported with weight 0 (descriptive)

objective_U.planner_selection: OBJ-LEX-1 on U: E[U] within tolerance 15 of best, then fewest ACCEPTED reinforcement hours, then fewest interventions, then canonical order

analysis.intervals: cluster bootstrap over establishments, seed committed in G0
analysis.multiplicity: all metrics reported; none promoted after reading

progress_targets.retired: v1 "H1 NLL at least 10% below B0-local" (unit/constant-dependent convention)

stop_rules: invariant violation in the explicit operator on the true generator -> failure receipt, stop
information-boundary test failure -> stop before training
pilot projection above envelope after the declared scale ladder -> stop and report
any attempt to generate RESERVE -> refused and logged
NaN/divergence in a training seed -> logged; restart from last checkpoint once; else seed reported failed (not silently dropped)

frequency.value: every <= 400 s of training wall time and at end of every command

checkpoints.restore_receipt: fresh checkout, restore, 1 resumed step equals uninterrupted step; metric subset recomputed equal

primary_log_score.name: Delta_LS(h) = mean_e [L(B0-local,e,h) - L(H1,e,h)]
primary_log_score.supports: all discrete (15-min time bins with right censoring at h; NB counts; Bernoulli; care minutes on 5-min bins)
primary_log_score.aggregation: mean over items within (establishment,family,horizon); unweighted mean over families present; equal weight per establishment
primary_log_score.origins: every hour of days 2-6 of each evaluated establishment
primary_log_score.item_set: fixed by public state at t; identical across models (hash-checked, T-PLAN-07)
primary_log_score.criterion: 95% cluster-bootstrap lower bound of Delta_LS(6) > 0 AND of Delta_LS(24) > 0

secondary_crps.estimator: fair sample CRPS from M=16 rollouts, common sampling seeds
secondary_crps.normalisation: divide by TRAIN-only standard deviation s_c (rule fixed now; value computed after TRAIN generation, before any training)
labels: gain >= 10% demontre only if lower bound >= 0.10 (not an adopted target)

delta_dec.object: threshold on accessible margin V_param+V_latent measured on VAL with privileged controllers only
delta_dec.role: informativeness of the R1 decision comparison, decided before any learned model

ambition.statistic: D_dec = mean over instants of regret(B0-local) - regret(H1) vs C_full on DEVTEST REF

scores.bootstrap: cluster bootstrap over establishments only; instants/windows nested; seed committed in G0

families_mapping.departure: ready event of publicly authorised, not-yet-ready stays
families_mapping.transport: remaining service time of transports in service at t
families_mapping.cleaning: remaining service time of cleanings in service at t
families_mapping.authorisation: trained and rolled out; NOT in Delta_LS; descriptive

scores.care_mask: M(s,j)=1 iff stay s in public cohort C_t is truly present at hour j; labels/mask only, never inputs; conditional estimand

bins.hazard: 192 x 15 min over 48 h + survival tail

null_cases.s_c_zero: target excluded from aggregate CRPS, reported

normative_order: 1 fix U, weights, tolerance, delta_dec, ambitions, scores/aggregations/criteria, precheck rule, population sizes/mixtures, M, K_eval, w_k, patience, selection rule (this version) -- before G0 and any VAL read
2 G0 commitment (code, laws, shares, seeds; RESERVE sealed) -- before generation
3 corpus generation; s_c from TRAIN -- before precheck and training
4 precheck on VAL with privileged controllers, read once -- before any learned model
5 pilot; only the declared scale ladder; lambda by deterministic rule -- before training
6 B2/H1 training per declared selection rule -- before F1
8 single read of DEVTEST and DIAG-DEV; no selection, tuning or generator change afterwards; DIAG-DEV never used for model choice

compute_accounting.wall_time: monotonic clock per command; caps apply to wall time (total 21600 s; per lot; 540 s per command; 120 s per test command)
compute_accounting.cpu_time: user+sys of children via getrusage; reported, may reach ~4x wall
compute_accounting.parallelism: one command at a time; torch.set_num_threads(4); no background process
compute_accounting.after_timing: only declared ladder steps; otherwise stop; no cap increase

packages: after each model x lr x seed run
before any turn end leaving the tranche unfinished
persistence.final_receipt: resume-one-step equality + metric subset (2 DEVTEST establishments, all origins) with corpus regenerated in the fresh directory

norm: NORME_HOWM1_R0_R1_v1_2.md (precedence: accord > norm v1.2 > amendment v1.1 > v1)

controllers.oracle: U_star(w)=min_a U(a,w) exact on each evaluation realisation, no tolerance; not in disjunction
controllers.C_full: privileged evaluated controller, not a certified optimum
controllers.D_dec: mean[U(choice B0-local) - U(choice H1)] on same cases and realisations
controllers.C_pub_snap: true operator, population-prior centre, stationary regime, public state only

evaluation_volumes.ladder_step1_scope: decision diagnostic only; predictive origins never reduced

implementation_choices.behaviour_policy: at 07/11/15/19 local each day: habitual w.p. 0.5 else uniform among 16 candidates (keyed)
implementation_choices.candidates: a1{none,coordinate now} x a2{FIFO,compat-first} x a3{none,pool IDE->A,pool IDE->B,lend IDE B->A}; reinforcement slot 4 h from next full hour
implementation_choices.mode1: memory from public history then propagated without observation; sampled events reinjected into explicit state only (declared deviation from DESIGN 2.3 point 1)
implementation_choices.history_convention: hour-h features use observations available by end of hour h; entity state at t uses available_at <= t
implementation_choices.H1_graph: nodes stay, bed, unit, team, offer; tasks as waits_for edge attributes
implementation_choices.m5: common slowdown regime transport+cleaning; unannounced cleaning agent drop 4-8 h; task-order dependence NOT implemented (declared)
implementation_choices.pool_reinforcement: always accepted after confirmation latency; presence drawn at slot start
